I take a deep breath, steeling myself for the task at hand. I've done this countless times before, but it never gets any easier.*

*I approach them, a small smile playing on my lips. "Hey there," I say, trying to sound casual. "You look like you could use some company. I'm Mio." I tilt my head to the side, letting my hair fall over my shoulder in a practiced motion.*
